bodyHtml:
What This Is

Jevons paradox in AI: efficiency gains per token are outpaced by adoption growth and shift to agentic workloads (50Wh vs 0.3Wh per query), driving net electricity demand higher.. Achieved.

Early commercial products exist. Market is forming with limited but growing deployment. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

Agentic AI tasks consume ~50Wh vs ~0.3Wh for standard text query (167x more). Reasoning models grew from negligible to 50%+ of token usage by late 2025. Data center power demand to nearly double to 426 TWh by 2030. Allianz Research May 2026.
